description: Scan BTC or ETH price gaps across Coinbase, Kraken, Bitstamp, Gemini and Uniswap v3 on Base, read now from their order books: for your size, every buy-here-sell-there pair with the net dollars after both taker fees, DEX gas and your transfer cost. Read only: nothing is traded. Costs 0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call, paid with x402 over MCP: call it without payment to get the PaymentRequired terms in structuredContent, then call it again with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. The settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. A call that cannot be done (bad input, the service busy) is never charged. The same service over HTTP: POST https://a-to-mind.com/api/x402/arbitrage.

fees.description: your taker fee per venue as a fraction, optional

transferUsd.description: cost to move the coin between venues, dollars (default 0: you hold both sides)

venues.description: coinbase, kraken, bitstamp, gemini, uniswap; optional

name: paid_arbitrage
title: Scan exchange price gaps (0.05 USDC, x402)
